newsitem.title: USA: NYSE Feb 3-7 program trading averaged 14 percent.
newsitem.headline: NYSE Feb 3-7 program trading averaged 14 percent.

text.p: The New York Stock Exchange said Thursday that program trading during February 3 to February 7 averaged 14 percent of daily volume of 522 million shares, or 73.3 million shares a day.
Of the average, buy programs accounted for 33.5 million shares a day and sell programs accounted for 39.8 million.
In all markets, program trading averaged 86.3 million shares a day during February 3-7.

Of the five member firms reporting the most program activity, BNP Securities and NatWest Securities executed all of their program activity for customers, as agent. Salomon Brothers and Goldman Sachs executed most of their program activity for customers, as agent or facilitator. First Boston executed most as principal, for its own accounts.
During February 3-7, 26.6 percent of program volume executed by NYSE firms related to index arbitragee, while another 1.3 percent involved derivative product-related strategies.
